description: Optional wallet login/register step 3 (not required if the agent already has an API key). Pass challenge + wallet signature from steps 1–2. isNewUser=true -> POST /api/registerUser; else POST /api/logon. On success, map body.requestToken/requestSecret to X-MBX-APIKEY / X-MBX-APISECRET; use body.id as account. Wallet signing stays outside MCP.

challenge.description: Challenge text returned by quote_trade_get_challenge (Sign auth token: ...).

isNewUser.description: From quote_trade_get_challenge. true -> registerUser; false -> logon. If omitted, logon is tried first then registerUser on failure.

signature.description: Wallet signature of the challenge text (0x-prefixed hex).

name: quote_trade_logon

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

credentialMapping.description: Present on success only. Maps this response's requestToken/requestSecret/id to the MCP client headers and account field to use next.

nextStep.description: Present on success only. What to configure before calling private tools.

title: Quote.Trade wallet logon / register
